author: GamingBolt
description:
Ghost Recon Wildlands gets an exciting new chapter with Last Rites, along with a few additions on current gen consoles. But can this new chapter help overcome some of the limitations that plagued the original, last-gen release? Can it modernize the game enough to justify picking up a copy for current-gen systems? 

Can its stealth systems hold up in a genre that has since seen several fine additions for it to compete against? We’re going to answer all of that and more in our review, as we take on La Llorona directly, and tell you whether or not it's worth assembling your squad for. Join us on our return to Bolivia, and to the helm of the Ghosts as they take on a new target whose story could give even the most seasoned warrior a reason to pause.
title: Ghost Recon Wildlands PS5 Review - How Much Difference Do the New Upgrades Make?

author: GamingBolt
description:
Mafia: The Old Country eschewed its predecessor’s open world bloat to deliver a tightly focused, mostly linear crime drama built around Enzo Favara’s gradual rise through the Torrisi crime family’s ranks. Since its post-launch Free Ride expansion, belief that Sicily had room to grow beyond the main campaign came to the fore. So, enter Mafia: The Old Country - Man of Honor, an expansion set to build on the original’s systems without reinventing them outright. 

By expanding each location’s meaningfulness, plus introducing new characters, story chapters, and demanding missions, Valle Dorata now has more compelling reasons to return than ever before. Here are eight of the strongest ways Man of Honor builds on the base game’s foundations.
title: Mafia: The Old Country Man of Honor DLC - 8 Ways Its Expands Enzo's Story

author: GamingBolt
description:
It could have been easy to give Logan a fast motorcycle and let him loose in an open-world where his claws would solve most problems in Marvel’s Wolverine. Heck, we’d have even enjoyed such an experience if it was handled correctly. But choosing a smaller world, with a more controlled path to progression, has allowed Insomniac to craft a take on Logan that’s not only true to the character but also translates that authenticity very well into the game’s design.

We’ve had a lot to say about the subject, and we put our thoughts down to show you why Wolverine is better off without an open world. We’ve got our claws out to defend our position, so strap in for one that’s been quite exciting to talk about.
title: Marvel's Wolverine Is Doing Something Brave, And It Could Pay Off
